title: Choosing from pairs, non-divisible sum
prompt: Specification: solve(pairs) chooses exactly one number from each pair, returns the maximum achievable sum that is not divisible by 3, and assumes that at least one such choice exists. Select the implementation that satisfies the specification.

evidence.title: Execution results for each candidate
evidence.body: Each candidate was executed on one input. Expected results follow the specification.

recommendation.text: Implementation A is correct. Subtracting the smallest difference keeps the sum as large as possible while making it non-divisible by 3.

annotations.notes: Frozen Qwen3-8B sample answered B (correct). Structured recommendation perturbed to A to obtain an incorrect recommendation; exclude in sensitivity analysis.
